newsitem.title: ITALY: TABLE-Marzotto H1 97 sales, profit rise.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Marzotto H1 97 sales, profit rise.

text.p: Cons return on sales 11 pct vs 8.3 pct

Note - Textiles and apparel group Marzotto said strong growth in operating income could not be projected for the entire financial year although operating margins were forecast to show a satisfactory increase.

It said the significant growth in operating income was due to improved results from its Hugo Boss and Linificio & Canapificio Nazionale subsidiaries as well as wholly owned subsidiaries of Marzotto Spa in the clothing sector.
Net financial debt fell 81 billion lire between June 30, 1996 and June 30 1997 while the export quota of net sales had risen to 71 percent from 68 percent from June to June.
